behavior_constraints: Adds a `critical` subcommand accepting `--spec <path>` and optional `--format text|json`.
Missing `--spec` exits 2 with non-empty `error: ...` on stderr and empty stdout.
Invalid `--format` value exits 2 with stderr-only `error: bad --format\n` and empty stdout.
`--only` is not supported and is rejected as an unknown flag with exit 2.
Any other unknown flag or positional argument exits 2 with non-empty stderr and empty stdout.
Invalid spec exits 2 with stderr-only `error: <code>: <message>\n` using existing validation codes.
On success, stdout ends with exactly one `\n` and nothing is written to stderr.
Computes job length as `length(j)=1+max(length(d) for d in deps(j))`, with `length(j)=1` when deps are empty.
Critical sink is the job with maximum length; ties broken by byte-order-first job name.
entities.summary: This round adds a read-only `critical` subcommand that validates a spec and emits the deterministic longest dependency chain in text or JSON form.

instruction_head:
# jobforge critical path

Add a new subcommand `critical` that reports the critical path (longest
dependency chain by job count) of the DAG.

All existing behavior is unchanged.

## New subcommand: `jobforge critical --spec <path> [--format text|json]`

Validates the spec (same error contract as existing subcommands). On
success, computes the critical path and emits it.
